id="i6LbPaipgGcD5Bv1dnUm" name="Page-2"> <mxGraphModel dx="2424" dy="2692" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml\ntitle Traffic Signal Controller - Class Diagram\n\n'========================================================\n' Enums & Data structures\n'========================================================\nenum PhaseId {\n NS_GREEN\n YELLOW\n ALL_RED\n EW_GREEN\n}\n\nclass Phase {\n + phaseId : PhaseId\n + durationMs : uint32_t\n}\n\nclass PlanData {\n + sourcePlanId : uint64_t\n + phases : Phase[MAX_PHASES]\n + phaseCount : uint8_t\n + totalCycleMs : uint32_t\n + isEmergencyNS : bool\n + isEmergencyEW : bool\n + receivedAt : uint64_t\n}\n\nstruct SignalOutput {\n + timestamp : uint64_t\n}\n\nclass SignalDisplay\n\nstruct DataCollect {\n + cycleId : uint64_t\n + sourcePlanId : uint64_t\n + nsGreenDurationMs : uint32_t\n + ewGreenDurationMs : uint32_t\n + yellowDurationMs : uint32_t\n + allRedDurationMs : uint32_t\n + isEmergencyCycle : bool\n + samples : SignalOutput[MAX_SAMPLES]\n + sampleCount : uint8_t\n}\n\nstruct LogEntry {\n + cycleData : DataCollect\n + loggedTimestamp : uint64_t\n}\n\n'========================================================\n' Components\n'========================================================\nclass PlanReceiver {\n - validPlanResult : bool\n - translatePlan() : PlanData\n + receivePlan(plan : PlanData) : void\n + validatePlan() : bool\n + accept() : void\n + reject() : void\n + forwardPlan() : PlanData\n}\n\nclass SignalFSMEngine {\n - remainingTimeMs : uint32_t\n - currentPhaseIndex : uint8_t\n - currentPlan : PlanData\n - isEmergencyNS : bool\n - isEmergencyEW : bool\n - hasNewPlan : bool\n - fsm() : void\n + processTick() : void\n + sendHeartbeat() : HealthStatus\n}\n\nclass OutputSimulator {\n + receiveSignalDisplay(display : SignalDisplay) : void\n + formatConsole() : void\n + sendToParticipants() : void\n}\n\nclass LatencyCollector {\n - sampleBuffer : SignalOutput[MAX_SAMPLES]\n + collectTimestamp(ts : SignalOutput) : void\n + computeLatency() : void\n + packageData() : DataCollect\n + sendToLogger(l : EventLogger) : void\n}\n\nclass EventLogger {\n + receiveDataCollect(data : DataCollect) : void\n + writeLogEntry() : LogEntry\n + sendToAnalytics(a : Analytics) : void\n}\n\nclass Analytics {\n + receiveLogEntry(entry : LogEntry) : void\n + computeStatistics() : void\n + buildHistogram() : void\n}\n\n'========================================================\n' Relationships - structural (composition)\n'========================================================\nPlanData *-- \"0..MAX_PHASES\" Phase : phases[]\nPhase --> PhaseId\nSignalFSMEngine *-- PlanData : currentPlan\nLatencyCollector *-- \"0..MAX_SAMPLES\" SignalOutput : sampleBuffer\nDataCollect *-- \"0..MAX_SAMPLES\" SignalOutput : samples[]\nLogEntry *-- DataCollect : cycleData\n\nnote right of PlanData\nThe Phase array is an internal\npre-translated phase sequence\nexecuted by the FSM Engine.\nNormal mode: 6 phases.\nEmergency mode: disabled phases\nare removed, leaving only active ones.\nend note\n\n'========================================================\n' Relationships - behavioral (sends / creates)\n'========================================================\nPlanReceiver --> SignalFSMEngine : sends PlanData\nPlanReceiver ..> PlanData : creates\n\nSignalFSMEngine --> LatencyCollector : sends SignalOutput\nSignalFSMEngine --> OutputSimulator : sends SignalDisplay\nSignalFSMEngine ..> SignalOutput : creates every tick\nSignalFSMEngine ..> SignalDisplay : creates every tick\n\nOutputSimulator ..> SignalDisplay : consumes\n\nLatencyCollector ..> DataCollect : creates\nLatencyCollector --> EventLogger : sends DataCollect\n\nEventLogger ..> LogEntry : creates\nEventLogger --> Analytics : sends LogEntry\n\nAnalytics ..> LogEntry : consumes for statistics\n\n@enduml",
 "config": null
